title: Face Identification via Polyhedral Relaxations for Binary Programs: A Comparison with Factor-Width Partial Facial Reduction
summary: Facial reduction (FR) is a preprocessing technique used to restore Slater's condition in semidefinite programming (SDP), but each step generally requires solving an auxiliary SDP. Factor-width-\(k\) partial FR restricts the class of exposing matrices. Increasing \(k\) enlarges this class, but, for \(k\geq3\), the auxiliary problem remains an SDP involving positive semidefinite blocks of order \(k\).
